title: Anne Carson — a declared absence: the books from Eros the Bittersweet to The Gender of Sound, and the translations from the Greek
edition: No edition held. The seat holds the declaration of what it would hold: declared/absence.json and declared/absence.md.

why_seated: MANUS, 27 October 2026, after the twenty-seventh seating entered Deleuze and Guattari as a declared absence: "and a declared absence/ wanted seating: hypatia, d & g, pkd, allen ginsberg, anne carson, and tao lin - including the mandalas. and paul klee. too many files and too many image copyright landmines." Anne Carson (b. 1950), awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature on 8 October 2026, is entered as wanted. She is living, and her works open seventy years after her death. They stand on the shelf's own ground: If Not, Winter translates the Sappho the shelf holds as fragment 31 (01/10), Autobiography of Red is built on Stesichorus, Economy of the Unlost reads Simonides with Celan.
ruling: A declared absence, the wanted seating: the works named, with their rights and opening dates, and no text (MANUS, 2026-10-27).
